label: Camcorder
depicts: Concentric camera lens ring with one inner circle inside one outer circle
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simple lens or record ring made from concentric circles.
avoid_when: Do not use for the handheld camcorder when the body, grip, and cord should remain visible.

label: Candy
depicts: Wrapped candy shape with an oval center and one twisted end on left and right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a classic wrapped sweet with pointed twist ends.
avoid_when: Do not use for the round candy when the top corners should look crimped instead of side wrapped.

label: Candy
depicts: Round wrapped candy with two crimped top corners and one inner shine mark

avoid_when: Do not use for the side wrapped candy when the ends should point left and right.

label: Cash
depicts: Rectangular banknote with four corner tabs and one centered circle
use_when: Use when the interface wants a flat banknote with decorative corner tabs and a center seal.
avoid_when: Do not use for the wavy banknote when the outer edges should curve like fabric.

label: Cash
depicts: Wavy banknote with one centered circle and one curved top edge
